## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences. Link the issue if there is one: "Closes #12". -->

> Base branch: **`development`**. Only maintainers open pull requests into `main`, from `development`.

## Kind of change

- [ ] A lesson or quiz (new, or a fix)
- [ ] An exercise (new, or a fix)
- [ ] A new stack: language, service, track or path
- [ ] The engine, the app or the installer
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 tools/build_guide.py` was run, and the generated files are committed
- [ ] `python3 tools/selftest.py <tracks I touched>` passes: every starter fails, every reference solution passes
- [ ] `python3 tools/test_app.py` passes (needed when the engine, the app or the installer changed)
- [ ] Every new exercise has a `README.md`, hints, and a reference solution in `solutions/`
- [ ] Every new lesson has a quiz
- [ ] The text is my own, or its licence allows it here and I named the source
- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal data are in the change
